Title: How to Prevent Auto-Archiving on Nintendo Switch
IntroLines: Want to stop your Nintendo Switch from automatically archiving your favorite games?
In this video, I'll show you how to prevent auto-archiving in just a few simple steps.

Sections.Heading: HOW TO PREVENT AUTO-ARCHIVING ON NINTENDO SWITCH
Steps: •  First, from your HOME Menu, select the " System Settings " gear icon.
•  Then, scroll down the left-hand menu and select " Data Management " .
•  On the right side of the screen, select " Manage Software " .
•  Find and select the specific game you want to protect from being archived.
•  Move down and select " Prevent Auto-Archiving " .
•  Toggle the setting to " On " to keep the game permanently installed.
•  Repeat this process for every individual game you do not want the console to automatically archive.
•  Finally, return to your HOME Menu and verify that your protected games stay on your console.

OutroLines: And that's how you can prevent auto-archiving on your Nintendo Switch.
